summary: Added Invalid Codes management (list + Excel export + Excel/CSV import) for Store-type audit sessions. Warehouse and Cycle Count flows are untouched and were tested to confirm zero regression.

new_endpoints.purpose: Lists scanned barcodes for a Store session that are NOT in master_products AND NOT in expected_stock. Returns {total, items:[{barcode, scanned_qty, locations[], sample_product_name}]}. Non-store clients receive HTTP 400.

Downloads a .xlsx template with one row per invalid barcode. Columns: barcode | correct_barcode (blank) | description | category | article_code | article_name | mrp | cost | [enabled schema extras]. User fills and re-uploads.

Accepts .xlsx/.csv. Per row: correct_barcode filled -> rewrite barcode inside synced_locations.items (auto-correct mis-scans). Master detail fields filled -> upsert into master_products with the resolved barcode (correct_barcode if given else original). Invalidates master+report caches; refreshes client.master_product_count. Returns counts.

frontend_changes_summary: Added 'Invalid Codes' button in Reports page header — visible ONLY when client.client_type === 'store' AND a session is selected.
Added modal with list of invalid codes, Export to Excel button, Import Filled Excel button.
Import success toast shows: rows_processed, items_replaced, masters_upserted.
After successful import: clears report cache so reports re-fetch with corrected data.

playwright.store_client: invalid-codes-btn visible = True; modal opens with 2 seeded invalid codes; Export + Import buttons present

api_curl.list_store_session: Returns 2 invalid codes with qty + locations.
api_curl.warehouse_rejection: HTTP 400 - 'Invalid Codes feature is available only for Store clients'
api_curl.export_xlsx: Generates valid .xlsx with correct headers + pre-filled barcode column.
api_curl.import_xlsx: Replaces synced_locations barcode (auto-correct works), upserts master row with provided details, increments master_product_count, list endpoint returns 0 invalid after import.

lint_status: Frontend: clean (no new warnings). Backend: only pre-existing E702 / F841 style warnings; no new errors from the added code.
test_data_cleanup: Seeded test synced_locations docs and master upserts were removed after verification.
next_actions: Real user workflow: scan store -> open Reports -> Invalid Codes button -> Export -> fill correct_barcode and/or master details -> Import -> reports auto-refresh.
